image_viewing_method: Direct multimodal read of both saved JPEG contact sheets (selected-page.jpg, selected-page-after.jpg) at full sheet scale; judged on pixels only, no OCR, no code execution, no file modification, no DESIGN.md/receipt/prior review consulted
visually_examined: header lockup and nav on all breakpoints
hero eyebrow, display headline, italic tagline, body paragraph
hero video still, overlay caption and carousel chrome
dark 'WELCOME TO TRIBAL' section headline and 4-up question grid
before_after_comparison: Tagline changed 'Stay for the people.' -> 'Make it your place.' (less generic, more specific to a neighborhood lounge); body copy now leads with 'alcohol-free' and 'neighborhood'; phone utility cluster rebuilt from a 3-row micro-caps table into two legible columns with the tiny 'RELAX · WORK · PLAY' row dropped; phone hero sequence now reads eyebrow -> display -> tagline -> body -> CTA pair -> address/hours -> photo without the footer-table feel. Tablet and desktop kept the old micro-caps utility cluster unchanged, so the fix is breakpoint-inconsistent.

page_review.comparison_to_references: Baseline screenshot is previous internal version; no external refs supplied

identity.observation: All breakpoints read 'TRIBAL KAVA / WEST PALM BEACH FL', 'KAVA, CONVERSATION & A PLACE TO BELONG', 'Your alcohol-free neighborhood kava lounge for first-timers and regulars', '770 S Military Trail', 'Open daily 8 AM-2 AM'. No banquet, event-rental, or book-the-space language anywhere in frame. Botanical is carried by the cream/forest-green/lime palette and serif display rather than by the photography, which is neon nightlife.
identity.reference_comparison: Baseline = previous internal version; no external refs supplied. Identity is clearer than baseline thanks to the added 'alcohol-free neighborhood' line.

hierarchy.observation: Phone order is eyebrow -> 2-line display -> italic tagline -> body -> paired CTAs -> two-column address/hours -> hero video -> lime marquee -> dark 'WELCOME TO TRIBAL'. The utility block no longer competes with or mimics a footer table. Desktop splits text column against the video cleanly.
hierarchy.reference_comparison: Baseline = previous internal version; the phone hierarchy is materially better than before.

typography.observation: Display serif with an italic second line is editorial and confident. Defects: tablet and desktop still set the address/hours in ~9-10px wide-tracked micro-caps, the smallest type on the page, while phone got the larger two-column version; desktop's italic line sits at roughly half the display size leaving an unresolved size step; the dark-section headline runs 4 lines on phone at very tight leading but does not collide.
typography.reference_comparison: Baseline = previous internal version; phone type scale improved, tablet/desktop micro-caps unchanged.

imagery.observation: Real, warm, specific people (tattooed man with cross necklace, four people at a pool table) satisfy the real-people requirement. But the hero is a video-carousel still and its chrome - dots, 'Pause', 'Longer' - is baked over the top-left of the frame on all three breakpoints; 'Longer' is low-contrast against the bright orange/green frame and reads as leftover player UI. The 'The good kind of company.' caption itself is legible over the dark gradient.
imagery.reference_comparison: Baseline = previous internal version; same chrome defect existed before and was not addressed.

rhythm.observation: Hero -> lime marquee ('COME AS YOU ARE · STAY FOR THE VIBE · REAL KAVA · REAL CONNECTION') -> dark 'THE SPOT YOU WISH YOU'D FOUND SOONER.' with a 4-up question grid. Phone now breathes between CTA and photo; tablet stacks text then image cleanly. Desktop sheet only reaches the top of the dark section, so desktop rhythm below the fold is not judged here.
rhythm.reference_comparison: Baseline = previous internal version; phone spacing is tighter and more intentional.

mobile.observation: Clear improvement: display headline is the first strong element, CTAs sit as an equal pair, address/hours are two legible columns, and the video starts a full beat lower with the man's face intact. Residual: the address block floats unlabeled between the buttons and the photo, reading as neither CTA nor caption, and the carousel controls remain tiny and low-contrast.
mobile.reference_comparison: Baseline = previous internal version; this is the dimension the revision most improved.

conversion.observation: 'EXPLORE THE MENU' and 'GET DIRECTIONS' paired on every breakpoint, 'Find Us' pinned in the header, full street address and daily hours above the fold on phone/tablet, plus 'First kava shell?', 'Two pool tables', 'daytime spot' and 'staying awhile' answers below.
conversion.reference_comparison: Baseline = previous internal version; conversion path is intact and slightly clearer.

findings.issue: Carousel chrome (dots, 'Pause', 'Longer') overlays the top-left of the photograph; 'Longer' is low-contrast over the bright orange/green frame and reads as leftover video-player UI rather than a designed control.
findings.fix: Consolidate into one high-contrast pill on the image edge or below the image, hide it on phone, and rename or remove 'Longer'.

findings.where: tablet and desktop hero utility cluster
findings.issue: Address and hours are still set as ~9-10px wide-tracked micro-caps, the smallest type on the page, and no longer match the phone's two-column treatment.
findings.fix: Port the phone's two-column address/hours block to tablet and desktop at >=12px, and drop or fold the 'RELAX · WORK · PLAY' tracking row into a single line.

findings.where: phone, between 'GET DIRECTIONS' and the hero photo
findings.issue: The address/hours block floats unlabeled in the gap, belonging to neither the CTA group nor the image caption.
findings.fix: Add a small 'FIND US'/'VISIT' label or a hairline rule to anchor it to one side.

findings.issue: The italic tagline sits at roughly half the display size, leaving an unresolved size step beside the 2-line display.
findings.fix: Raise the italic line or trim the display size so the two lines read as one lockup.

findings.issue: Botanical character is carried by palette and typography only; every photograph is neon nightlife.
findings.fix: Add one botanical still (plant, kava prep, shell) to the marquee or the dark section.
